audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. Wiring vertex omitted from two index ranges
limitations: Counterevidence and scope: Equations(2.7)-(2.9) already sum over all E_N, including wiring edges. Immediately after(4.9) the source explicitly adds h_i exp(u_i);(4.11) removes the rho row of the incidence matrix but explicitly keeps pinning-edge columns, and(4.13) gives D=F W F^T. Including rho in incident sums yields v^T D v=sum_internal W_ij exp(u_i+u_j)(v_i-v_j)^2+sum_i h_i exp(u_i)v_i^2. Connectedness to rho means each internal component has positive pinning, so this form is strictly positive for nonzero v. These adjacent intended objects remove the two displayed obstructions; no invalid intended core derivation or counterexample to the transience/moment theorems is established. Minor is appropriately scoped.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
